summary:
Iteration 78 — Frontend-only verification of the Plain-theme sub-card flattening on the tool detail page. Authenticated as ryan@ryan.com via direct /api/auth/login + localStorage token injection (the visible login form on this preview takes >15s to mount which broke testID-driven login). Probed computed styles in the live DOM at /tool/{id} after switching to Plain Light and Plain Dark via /more > theme-family-plain > appearance-light / appearance-dark. PASS criteria: the IMMEDIATE wrapper around each section item must NOT have its own border/background (i.e. no sub-card), while the OUTER big box keeps its border. RESULTS: (1) MAINTENANCE Plain Light + Plain Dark — first bordered ancestor of `mark-serviced-*` appears only at depth 4 (the outer big box, 2px border, white/dark bg, 6px radius). Depths 0–3 have borderWidth=0 and transparent bg => `rowFlat` is correctly applied. (2) WARRANTY Plain Light + Plain Dark — first bordered ancestor of `edit-warranty-link` appears only at depth 2 (the outer big box). Immediate warranty wrapper is transparent / borderless => `cardFlat` correctly applied. (3) DETAILS / PHOTOS / HISTORY tabs render with their testIDs and no red-screen on both Plain skins. (4) DOCUMENTS tab renders flat, but the selected tool had 0 documents so no `doc-open-*` rows were available for runtime style introspection; the renderDocuments() code wraps Documents+Receipts in a single boxStyle separated by tabSectionDivider when !isIndustrial — verified by source review. (5) DASHBOARD REGRESSION: home-dealers-widget / home-dealers-header / home-details-box / home-row-{total_items,invested,checked_out,open_claims} all render after the run; the dealer widget innerText reads `DEALER ACCOUNTS
Snap-on Tools $1285.50 (overdue 13d)
Matco $640.00
Mac $410.25
Cornwell $5.00
TOTAL $2340.75` — no broken/blank section, no regression vs iter77. (6) Zero JS pageerrors, zero React-Native red screens, only standard RN-Web deprecation warnings (textShadow*, shadow*, pointerEvents). LIMITATIONS: (a) STEEL theme accordion did not expose `appearance-*` ids after a single click on `theme-family-steel` in this run (likely an Expo-web accordion render-timing race), so Steel/Iron paths were NOT runtime-verified — code review CONFIRMS renderDocuments() / boxStyle gate cleanly on `isIndustrial`, and section components use `useSkin()` to skip the *Flat style variants on non-plain skins. (b) ryan@ryan.com's 15-item inventory contains NO bundle tools (is_bundle=true), so the Sets/Bundle exception (expansions should still look like cards) could not be runtime-verified; the BundleTab code path was untouched in this iteration.
action_items: (QA gap, low priority) Steel/Iron tool-detail tabs (Documents, Maintenance, Warranty) were not runtime-validated this iteration — accordion expansion under theme-family-steel timed out for `appearance-*` testIDs after a single click. Suggest exposing a stable testID on the steel/iron color rows (or auto-expanding the family that contains current appearance) so future test agents can flip skins deterministically. Code review confirms the gating logic is correct.

(QA gap, low priority) ryan@ryan.com has no bundle/set tools, so the 'Sets/Bundle exception keeps cards' couldn't be runtime-asserted. Either (a) seed one bundle on ryan@ryan.com for regression, or (b) document that mechanicltz@gmail.com / smoketest user should be used for Sets/Bundle regression.
critical_code_review_comments: tool/[id].tsx renderDocuments() correctly branches on `isIndustrial` — Steel/Iron get two separate boxStyle wrappers (DocumentsSection + ReceiptsSection), Plain themes get a single boxStyle with a tabSectionDivider between them. Clean.

DocumentsSection.tsx adds `docRowFlat` + `docRowFlatLast` style variants gated on `skin === 'plain'`; original `docRow` (background, border, radius) untouched for non-plain skins. No shared-style regressions.
MaintenanceSection.tsx adds `rowFlat` + `rowFlatLast` gated on `isPlain`. Identical pattern, no shared-style edits.
WarrantySection.tsx adds `cardFlat` applied to both the filled-state `styles.card` and the empty-state `styles.emptyCard`. Correctly preserves the original card chrome for industrial skins.
All three section components import `useSkin` from `themeContext` consistently — no duplicate skin logic, no prop drilling.
No new expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch imports introduced. No deprecated package usage.

Login form takes a noticeably long time (>15s) to mount on this preview URL — testID-based login is brittle; consider preloading the login bundle or showing a deterministic skeleton with a testID like `auth-form-ready`.

success_rate.frontend: Plain Light + Plain Dark: 5/6 tabs runtime-verified (Documents flat-render confirmed via code review only — no docs in seed). Steel/Iron + Bundle: code-review-only (data/UI gap noted).

seed_data_creation: No data created. Authenticated as ryan@ryan.com (15-tool inventory, real dealer/maintenance/warranty data) per /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login on this preview URL: do NOT rely on the visible login form rendering within 15s. Use POST /api/auth/login directly via page.evaluate(), then localStorage.setItem('tt.auth.token', resp.token), then reload — works reliably. Useful testIDs: tool detail tabs use testID=`tab-{details|bundle|photos|documents|maintenance|warranty|history}` (defined at app/tool/[id].tsx:2609); flat-vs-card probing pattern that worked this iteration: climb parentElement from `mark-serviced-*` / `edit-warranty-link` / `doc-open-*` and find the FIRST ancestor with getComputedStyle().borderWidth !== '0px' — if that depth is the outer big box (typically 2px border + 6px radius) the inner row is correctly flat. Theme switch on /more: theme-family-{plain,steel,iron} > appearance-{light,dark,steel-*,iron-*}; the accordion is single-open, so clicking another family collapses the previous — after clicking the family, wait at least 1.5s before querying appearance-* children. ryan@ryan.com has NO is_bundle tools, so Sets/Bundle UI cannot be exercised under this account.
rca_of_issue: No bugs found. The Plain-theme sub-card flattening for Documents / Maintenance / Warranty on /tool/[id] is correctly implemented: each section component reads `useSkin()`, applies *Flat style variants only when skin==='plain', the outer big boxStyle remains untouched, Documents+Receipts share one boxStyle on plain skins, and the dashboard dealer regression that affected the prior fork does NOT reproduce.
